overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated basil leaves for food manufacturers, distributors, private label brands, and export buyers. The product is prepared from selected basil leaves, cleaned, dried under controlled conditions, and sieved to the required cut range. It offers a practical dry ingredient format for commercial production, with stable handling and convenient storage.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we support bulk supply, OEM and private label programs, and custom packaging on request. Buyers can choose standard packs or discuss mesh size, labeling, and packing format before production. We also provide sample support and export documentation assistance for smoother commercial sourcing.
